capabilities: add randomly selected notes as file nodes to the active canvas
pick notes randomly from all markdown files in the vault
pick notes randomly from the active search results
configure the number of notes and their grid positions when running the command
extras: The README warns that because no official Canvas API exists, the plugin edits underlying canvas data directly, so running commands in quick succession can leave the canvas out of sync.
intentEvidence: This plugin can be used to add notes to the Obsidian canvas view.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to pull random notes, or notes matching the current search, onto a canvas for browsing or review.
summary: Canvas utility that adds randomly selected vault notes as a grid of file nodes to the active Obsidian canvas.
